title: Little .io style game I've been working on in my free time called 'Tank Game'
author: Bk4180
selftext:
I've been working on this for a few days now and have put it out there at [tankgame.dev](https://tankgame.dev) today. It's a pretty addicting little .io game where you play as a tank and fight other tanks to gain experience. You can choose between 4 different weapons that all play differently. Leveling up gives you skill points that you can use to buff your base stats, and each weapon has its own specific base stats. 

One you reach level 30 you can choose to 'Rebirth' at the center of the map for a 'Rebirth Crystal'. These can be used in the homepage under the research section to unlock paths of a skill tree that give you permanent buffs for future runs.

I've been having a lot of fun just building and playing this, so feel free to give it a try! I'd love to hear feedback on what could be improved upon/added/etc.
